title: Strings that start or end with white space
notes: White space at either end of a plain scalar is not part of its value, so the string is quoted. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
